targets.authors: Desrochers TM, Chatham CH, Badre D
targets.title: The necessity of rostrolateral prefrontal cortex for higher-level sequential behavior.
targets.outcome_quote: Across two separate experiments, we have replicated and extended the prior observation that ramping activation in the RLPFC accompanies sequential task performance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict across both experiments confirms ramping activation; manipulations extend this finding.

reasoning: Two new independent fMRI samples retest the published Desrochers et al. finding while manipulating task features. Matching title, authors and DOI in full article, including references.
